blurb: Guests join private fishing charters targeting various species including bottom fish, striped bass, bluefish, sharks, haddock, codfish, and bluefin tuna. Trips range from 4 hours to full day excursions with experienced captains. The boat is a 30 foot Black Watch equipped with modern amenities and safety equipment.
extraNote: $100 deposit required to confirm booking · Full refund of deposit if cancelled at least 3 days in advance · Cancellation less than 3 days is at captain’s discretion · Trips may be cancelled due to inclement weather at captain’s discretion with refund or reschedule option · Skippy’s Pier One, South Yarmouth, MA for most trips; Onset Town Pier, Wareham, MA for Black Seabass & Scup trips
